summary: The PHI dossiers are accurate on the 2026-27 team story, schedule and arena (they match the live facts), but a live spot-check found one dead business central to the brief (Ubiq, closed Jan 2024) and a cross-dossier contradiction over Jaylen Brown (he declined a Nike offer and runs 741; culture said he left Nike and retail files treated him as a Nike signature driver). Ten dossier fixes were made in place (arena name, Nike uniform start year, Tierra Whack neighborhood, Barbacoa street, unverified award years, Big 5 Classic field, Divine Lorraine and Mummers dates). The strategy brief needs the editor to remove Ubiq, stop treating "Broad Street" as the shipped City Edition, retime the October open-call, and replace unverified small doors (Brewerytown Beats). Most small venues and 2027 dates are queued as unverifiable.
